outcomes.HIERARCHY_DEGRADES_RERANKING: valid run; no frozen primary metric improves and at least one is lower
outcomes.HIERARCHY_IMPROVES_RERANKING: valid run; all five frozen primary metrics improve over B0
outcomes.HIERARCHY_MIXED_RESULT: valid run; at least one frozen primary metric improves and at least one does not
outcomes.INVALID_HIERARCHY_EXPERIMENT: any scientific-integrity invariant failure; excluded from selection
